validation.notes: Repaired the authorization-to-effect chain in three production modules and validated it with a cross-module vm-graph regression that links the real modules (execution/effect-gate.ts, execution/tools.ts, session/values.ts, session/types.ts, session/commit.ts, runtime/progress.ts, runtime/drive/tool-placement.ts, runtime/drive/tools.ts) with boundary fakes only for pi-ai validateToolArguments, ../context.ts withAbortSignal, session/session.ts SessionInvariantError and a minimal durable Lane/Drive pair over an in-memory value store. 10 cases pass on the repair: (1) gate.admit refuses while a cancellation is durable even though the abort signal has not been signalled yet, (2) gate.admit rethrows the owner error after close and still admits while open, (3) executeToolCall passes the cleared args (a before_tool replacement) to the tool instead of the model arguments, (4) no effect starts when admission is refused, (5) a doubly declared safe replay uses the persisted checkpoint arguments ('persisted', not the stale model argument 'from-model'), clears the old pi.pending.tool_output checkpoint before invocation, checkpoints progress during the effect, and publishes the staged outcome exactly once after the effect, after the durable progress write and after live update delivery, (6) tool-only safe, (7) checkpoint-only safe, (8) missing tool, (9) cancellation winning admission, and (10) closed gate all stay interrupted/refused without invoking the effect (interrupted outcomes keep the durable checkpoint details and append the interruption marker). Ordering is proven with an ordered write/observation log and promise-controlled async gates, no timers, randomness or network. Faulty-baseline detection was verified by restoring each source file alone to its git baseline: runtime/drive/tools.ts, execution/effect-gate.ts and execution/tools.ts each make the run fail with an assertion error (no crash or import error), while the repaired tree passes; extra temporary probes for removing the pre-invocation checkpoint delete and for publishing the outcome before the effect finishes were also detected. Vitest/project test scripts could not be run because node_modules is absent and dependencies may not be installed; this limitation is recorded here instead of in a separate artifact.
